propositions: The project portability criterion's matrix cell treats CI as undifferentiated, leaving 'no CI provider' unnameable and preventing detection of GitHub-Actions-only hard dependencies.

A capability whose sole trigger is a specific CI system (e.g. GitHub Actions schedule) with no operation-linked or in-process fallback is not portable and silently breaks adopters with no CI or different CI providers.

The rubric detection text, docs mirror, and test assertions must all pin the expanded matrix cell listing 'CI under any provider' and 'projects with NO CI provider at all' plus the no-CI-provider rule, to prevent silent drift.
Live A/B testing confirms the new rubric detects a GitHub-Actions-only compaction trigger as a project.portability finding while the pre-change rubric stays silent on the identical plan.
